items.raw_excerpt: Festival no Paço do Frevo segue até segunda-feira (14), com espetáculo de dança, orquestra e blocos tradicionais.
items.summary_en: Recife celebrates National Frevo Day with a street parade and free admission to the Paco do Frevo cultural center. The festival features dance performances, live orchestra, and traditional frevo groups. Events run through Monday the 14th.

items.raw_excerpt: Paid accommodation in Alicante has left dozens of Icelanders seeking replacement lodging and legal advice.
items.summary_en: Icelanders who booked accommodations in Alicante, Spain are now seeking replacement lodging and legal advice. The paid bookings fell through, leaving travelers without places to stay.

items.raw_excerpt: As Bathla was being buried under mounting debts, the family behind it amassed a portfolio of luxury properties.
items.summary_en: The family behind Australian building company Bathla Group bought many expensive homes while the company owed more and more money. The property portfolio grew as the firm struggled with mounting debts.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay will flag off the Silverstone Motor Race, with actor Ajith competing and advocating for motorsport events in India.
items.summary_en: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay gave the start signal at the Silverstone motor race in the United Kingdom. Actor Ajith took part in the race. Vijay also spoke about bringing more motor racing events to India.

items.raw_excerpt: If you are looking for a beach where you can spend the whole day, Tavira Island is a great choice. A beautiful stretch of white sand, clear water and plenty of restaurants and bars make it one of the most popular beach destinations in the eastern Algarve.
items.summary_en: Tavira Island is a great beach destination in eastern Algarve, Portugal. It has beautiful white sand and clear water. There are plenty of restaurants and bars to enjoy all day.

items.raw_excerpt: As we build more homes to tackle the housing crisis some worry trees will become collateral damage. But as our climate changes, isn't now the time we need trees most?
items.summary_en: As Australia builds more homes to tackle the housing crisis, some worry that trees will become collateral damage. However, as the climate changes, many argue that trees are needed more than ever.

items.raw_excerpt: Una foca leopardo fue encontrada varada en la Playa del Deporte de Viña del Mar. Personal de la Policía Marítima llegó hasta el lugar, resguardó al animal y mantuvo alejadas a las personas mientras se evaluó su condición.
items.summary_en: A leopard seal was found stranded on Playa del Deporte in Viña del Mar. Maritime Police arrived to secure the area and keep people away while the seal's condition was being evaluated.

items.raw_excerpt: È la prima città rinascimentale costruita “a misura d’uomo”
items.summary_en: Pienza is a small town in Tuscany that was redesigned in the 1450s as an ideal Renaissance city by Pope Pius II. Its central square and buildings were planned with precise geometry and human-scale proportions. Today it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site surrounded by the rolling hills of Val d'Orcia.
items.summary_ko: 빈첸차는 1450년대 교황 피우스 2세가 르네상스 이상 도시로 설계한 토스카나의 작은 마을이다. 광장과 건물들이 정밀한 기하학과 사람 친화적 비례에 맞춰 배치되었다. 오늘날에는 발도르차 언덕에 둘러싸인 유네스코 세계유산으로 남아 있다.
items.title_en: Italy's first perfectly designed Renaissance town still stands in Tuscany
items.title_ko: 이탈리아 토스카나에 자리한 최초의 르네상스 이상 도시, 빈첸차
items.title_original: È la prima città rinascimentale "perfetta" e sì, si trova in Italia - Esquire

items.raw_excerpt: Giữa tháng Bảy, nhà văn Nguyễn Nhật Ánh trình làng tác phẩm Chuyện tình thị trấn (NXB Trẻ). Ông cho biết, đây là truyện dài thứ tư ông lấy bối cảnh thị trấn Hà Lam - một địa danh có thật, nay thuộc xã Thăng Bình (Đà Nẵng).
items.summary_en: Vietnamese author Nguyen Nhat Anh released a new book called 'Love Story of the Town' in mid-July. He said it is his fourth novel set in Ha Lam, a real small town now part of Da Nang.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 작가 Nguyễn Nhật Ánh이 7월 중순 'Chuyện tình thị trấn'이라는 새 책을 출간했습니다. 그는 이 소설이 실제 마을인 Ha Lam을 배경으로 한 네 번째 장편이라고 밝혔으며, Ha Lam은 현재 Da Nang시 Thang Binh면에 속해 있습니다.
items.title_en: Vietnamese Author Releases Book Set in Ha Lam Town

items.raw_excerpt: “Một căn phòng không có sách khác nào một cơ thể chẳng có tâm hồn” - Triết gia Marcus Tullius Cicero đã nói như vậy cách đây hơn 2.000 năm.
items.summary_en: Da Nang's Book Street is called the cultural heart of the city. It is a place where people enjoy books and reading. About 2,000 years ago, the philosopher Cicero said a room without books is like a body without a soul.
items.summary_ko: 다낭의 책 거리는 도시의 문화적 심장이라 불립니다. 사람들이 책과 독서를 즐기는 이곳은 도시의 자랑입니다. 철학자 키케로는 약 2천 년 전 책 없는 방은 영혼 없는 몸과 같다고 했습니다.
items.title_en: Book Street - the cultural heart of Da Nang
